title: First run: no storefront ready
summary: DJDL just turned Commerce on and no storefront is ready, so Storefronts opens on a three-step setup card (connect a storefront, create an offer, make a test purchase) with the App Store offered as one confirmation because the team key already sees DJDL, then the storefronts that fit DJDL's macOS and Windows builds, all Not set up except Polaris Key's free Discover listing.
compare: The setup card shows while the commerce service is on, until the first verified purchase arrives (test purchases count); a storefront turning Ready doesn't remove it (commerce.first-run-connected). Steps are computed from facts, never stored.

The setup card has Home's Platform ready meter, one continuous bar ('0 of 3 done', empty track visible in both themes), and three rows: Connect a storefront (marked Next, primary action), Create an offer (can be done first; offers don't need a storefront), Make a test purchase (the one test-purchase switch inline).

Connect App Store is one confirmation (commerce.connect-app-store) because the platform's App Store Connect key already lists com.example.djdl (A-33): the copy says 'same key, no settings to type'. No bundle id or Apple ID field appears anywhere. Its failure stays inline in that dialog (commerce.connect-app-store-error).
The list shows only storefronts that fit DJDL's platforms (App Store, Steam, Microsoft Store, itch.io, Polaris Key); Google Play is absent because DJDL has no Android build.

Each storefront row says what it needs in plain words and how many human steps ('One step', '3 steps', '4 steps'), is one link to that channel's Sales tab where its wizard lives (commerce.sales-wizard shows Steam's), and has no buttons of its own.
itch.io says up front that its purchases can't be checked yet; Polaris Key reads 'Live, free' and says paid checkout isn't available yet.
The info callout reassures that DJDL's own site and its members-group licenses are unchanged and that store purchases land on the same licenses.
No stats, attention card or empty tables are drawn in this state.
Phone: the meter drops under the card title, each task's action goes under its text, and each storefront row puts its state under the name.

designReview.reviewer: UX designer (visual critique of rendered screenshots)
designReview.verdict: Fixed: the connect confirmation, its failure, the state after connecting and the Steam wizard are drawn as their own screens, and the meter is Home's bar.

findings.issue: [flow / missing states] The 'one confirmation' behind Connect App Store isn't drawn, nor its failure, nor the Sales-tab wizard behind every Not set up row.
findings.resolution: Added commerce.connect-app-store (the confirm naming the Example Audio team key, the app it found and what turns on together per A-33), commerce.connect-app-store-error (inline error: the key's Developer role can't read in-app purchases; give it App Manager in Users and Access → Integrations, Try again; the other failures are listed in its compare), commerce.first-run-connected (1 of 3 with Connect ticked, App Store Ready) and commerce.sales-wizard (DJDL's Steam Sales tab on Not set up, human steps only).

findings.issue: [visual] The '0 of 3 done' meter is three segments while Home uses one continuous bar, and the empty segments almost vanish in dark.
findings.resolution: Reuses Home's .progress bar (success, 220px wide, at 0%) with the empty track raised to a border-strong mix so it shows in both themes. Phone puts it under the card title.
